title: Practice 12: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Сопрано получила оглушительные аплодисменты за ___ (своё выступление, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The soprano received thunderous applause for her performance.
exercises.why: **выступление → выступление** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → свое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with выступление). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. выступление · выступления · выступлению · выступление · выступлением · выступлении; pl. выступления · выступлений · выступлениям · выступления · выступлениями · выступлениях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он спрятал письмо под ___ (подсвечник, acc. sg.) и закрыл глаза.
exercises.why: **подсвечник → подсвечник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. подсвечник · подсвечника · подсвечнику · подсвечник · подсвечником · подсвечнике; pl. подсвечники · подсвечников · подсвечникам · подсвечники · подсвечниками · подсвечниках.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**волынка → волынку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. волынка · волынки · волынке · волынку · волынкой · волынке; pl. волынки · волынок · волынкам · волынки · волынками · волынках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**поезд → поезд** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **товарный → товарный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with поезд). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. поезд · поезда · поезду · поезд · поездом · поезде; pl. поезда · поездов · поездам · поезда · поездами · поездах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Дед легонько поталкивал лаптями под ___ (брюхо, acc. sg.) кобылы.
exercises.why: **брюхо → брюхо** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. брюхо · брюха · брюху · брюхо · брюхом · брюхе; pl. брюхи · брюх · брюхам · брюхи · брюхами · брюхах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
